verdict.rationale: Hightouch supports transforming, filtering, and enriching data with SQL, dbt, or a visual builder in warehouse models before syncing to destinations, with field mapping per sync (docs-2, docs-23, docs-27, docs-48). However, events are collected into the warehouse first, and the docs say the processing logic moves to the warehouse (docs-5, docs-40). Nothing shows in-stream event transformations or custom code functions applied before events reach destinations. Missing for 10: in-pipeline event transformation or filtering functions, support for custom code (e.g. JavaScript/Python) on events in flight, and documentation or independent corroboration of real-time event enrichment before delivery.
